issues.jp_before: 美術[びじゅつ]{の|no-possessive}先生[せんせい]{は/が|wa-topic}生徒[せいと]{に|causative-o-ni}自分[じぶん]{の|no-possessive}顔[かお]{を|o-object}描[えが]かせました。
issues.problem: Furigana: for pupils drawing pictures in art class the natural reading of 描く is かく, not えがく.
issues.action: Changed reading to 描[か]かせました.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{は/が|wa-topic}熱[ねつ]{の|no-possessive}ある生徒[せいと]{を/に|causative-o-ni}早[はや]く帰[かえ]らせました。
issues.problem: The の in 熱のある is the subject marker in a relative clause (= 熱がある), not possessive; が is an equally natural alternative.

issues.jp_before: 看護師[かんごし]{は/が|wa-topic}患者[かんじゃ]{を|causative-o-ni}ベッド{で|de-place}休[やす]ませました。
issues.problem: With intransitive 休む and the permissive 'let' reading, 患者に休ませた is also natural; に was missing as an alternative.
issues.action: Focus slot changed to {を/に|causative-o-ni}; why updated.

issues.action: Focus slot changed to {を/に|causative-o-ni}; why updated.
